text: Re-grade criteria updated for the three-tier epic (bd-01KX94HQ7CA0NF2ZCH5V3PF3B3): (1) the scale-coherence soundness hole fixed with a regression test; (2) all Tier 1 landed (titles, theme incl. panel bg/grid, colorbar, science geoms, fixed aspect); (3) Tier 2 landed or explicitly deferred with policy (facets, typed stats, band scales, platform text metrics, heterogeneous layers); (4) no declared enum member runtime-rejected (creed); (5) extraction-readiness guard green; (6) conformance green on all four backends; (7) testAll green JVM+JS. Grade against the original 10/10 criteria; file follow-ons for anything below 10.
